summary.text: Russet Perry is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia, representing District 31, serving since 2024.
The district covers part of Fauquier County and part of Loudoun County.
The Senate biography lists Russet Perry's occupation as lawyer.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists George Washington University and Georgetown University Law Center for education, with two B.A. degrees and a J.D.
Russet Perry serves on the Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources; Courts of Justice; Education and Health; and Privileges and Elections committees.
